title: Repurposing bauxite residue (a waste material) as an adsorbent for removing PFAS from water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00101C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jingya Pang, Huixin Qiu, Scott Berggren, Himanshu Tanvar, Brajendra Mishra, Maricor J. Arlos
This study revealed that activated bauxite residue (ABR) can remove PFAS from water, and its utilization for wastewater treatment can promote better management of bauxite residue waste.
